claim: Selectively pruning reasoning-related neurons in a post-trained reasoning LLM improves its safety behavior on harmful prompts.
falsifier: In a post-trained reasoning LLM, identify reasoning-related neurons (e.g., via activation patching or attribution) and ablate them; measure the change in refusal rate on harmful prompts compared to random ablation.

conditions: The model has undergone post-training that over-activates reasoning mechanisms
Pruning is applied to reasoning-related neurons (not random neurons)
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported LRMs (R1-7B, R1-8B) and the specific pruning method used; transfer to other models or pruning criteria is unestablished.

title: Pruning of neurons identified for Increase in safe responses
